sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game features a scoring system where you earn points for each enemy ship you destroy. The more ships you destroy, the higher your score will be. However, be careful not to let your shield get damaged, as this will result in a game over. The game also features power-ups that can help you improve your gameplay and achieve higher scores.

Another key feature of Missile Fire is its high score challenge. The game features a leaderboard where you can compete with other players to achieve the highest score. This adds an extra layer of excitement to the game, as you'll be motivated to improve your gameplay and beat your high score.
